subject: Dedicated GPU pool sizing + migration credit — final approval request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Revised ask: 24-GPU reserved commit + migration credit

Marcus —

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Our procurement team ran the numbers and we can commit to a 12-month reserved pool if Redwood can meet two things: (1) match the competitor pricing we received (they quoted a 22% discount off list for a 24-A100 equivalent pool) and (2) provide a one-time migration credit to help cover data-movement and validation (~$120k).

We also need a throughput guarantee for production: 95th pct token latency under 200ms for our steady-state workload. If you can send a formal quote with these concessions, we can start legal next week.

Attached is a short summary of our expected PGW load and the competitor proposal for reference.

Thanks —
Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of ML Platform, NovaHealth
Attachment: competitor_quote_novah.pdf (referenced)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised ask: 24-GPU reserved commit + migration credit

Samantha —

Appreciate the clarity and the numbers. We can size a Dedicated pool at 24 A100-equivalent GPUs and guarantee a 95th pct token latency under 200ms for the steady-state profile in your doc, provided we agree on the traffic profile and burst policy in the SLA appendix.

On pricing: our standard Dedicated pricing for a 12-month commit that size is $X/month (see attached cost breakdown). I can offer a 20% subscription discount and a $50k one-time migration credit from my regional quota, which would get you close to your target but not fully match the 22% + $120k credit you shared.

If you require a deeper concession (22% + $120k), I need an executive exception and finance approval — looping in Marissa to fast-track. Please let me know if the 20% + $50k is acceptable as a counter-proposal and we can move to contracting.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: cost-breakdown-24gpu.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised ask: 24-GPU reserved commit + migration credit

Looping Ben for an exec decision — NovaHealth is strategic in healthcare verticals and this deal could unlock other hospital systems if we show flexibility. Marcus: summary of the ask for approval below (please confirm numbers are accurate before Ben signs off):

- Customer: NovaHealth (enterprise ML platform)
- Commit: 24 A100-equivalent GPUs, 12 months
- SLA: p95 token latency <200ms (steady-state) + 99.9% uptime
- Customer requested concession: 22% subscription discount + $120,000 one-time migration credit
- Marcus ask: approval for 22% + $120k OR alternative we can offer: 20% + $50k + 90-day onboarding success guarantee and a case study commitment.

Ben — can you approve the alternative package (20% + $50k + success guarantee) or do you prefer to match the competitor and grant the full exception? If you want terms tightened (e.g., case study + onboarding milestones) we can add those as conditions.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised ask: 24-GPU reserved commit + migration credit

Marissa / Marcus —

Thanks for the summary. I discussed with finance and legal. Given NovaHealth's go-to-market footprint and the likelihood of additional dedicated commitments from two referenced hospitals, I am willing to approve an exception with the following guardrails:

1) Subscription discount: 22% off list for the first 12-month commit (one-time exception).
2) Migration credit: capped at $100,000 (we will apply $100k as a credit on the first invoice).
3) Onboarding milestones: three checkpoints (week 2 smoke test, week 6 production cutover, week 12 review). Credit applies only if checkpoints are reached and customer completes agreed validation artifacts.
4) Contractual clause: a 12-month minimum term; early termination triggers pro-rated clawback of the migration credit.

Legal will draft the SLA appendix and the onboarding milestones. Marcus — please update the commercial proposal and confirm acceptance. Samantha — if those conditions are acceptable, we'll send revised contract and DocuSign link.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised ask: 24-GPU reserved commit + migration credit

Ben — thanks, that package is fair and aligns closely with NovaHealth needs. I'll incorporate the $100k cap, onboarding milestones, and the 22% discount into the proposal and route to legal.

Samantha — attached is the revised commercial with the approved exception. Highlights: 22% off list for year 1, $100k migration credit applied to first invoice, 3 onboarding milestones (detailed in SLA appendix), 12-month minimum term + credit clawback on early termination. Please confirm and I'll kick off DocuSign.

Attachment: nova_proposal_v2.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novahealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised ask: 24-GPU reserved commit + migration credit

Marcus / Ben / Marissa —

Thank you — NovaHealth accepts the revised economics and the onboarding milestones. We appreciate the flexibility on the migration credit and the clear milestone conditions. Legal will expect the DocuSign link and the SLA appendix by end of day Monday.

Next steps:
- Redwood to upload final contract to DocuSign (Marcus)
- NovaHealth legal to review (procurement@novahealth.com)
- Kickoff call scheduled for 2026-12-10 (I will share calendar invite)

Samantha Lee
Head of ML Platform, NovaHealth
Attachment: signed-nda.pdf (already on file)
